no-restricted-syntax.message: Hardcoded English text in JSX — route it through next-intl (t('key')) instead of a literal string. If this is genuinely not user-facing copy (e.g. a brand name), add an eslint-disable-next-line comment with why.
Hardcoded English text in a JSX attribute (aria-label/alt/title/placeholder) — route it through next-intl (t('key')) instead of a literal string.
Hardcoded English text in a template literal passed to a JSX attribute (aria-label/alt/title/placeholder) — move the literal part into a next-intl key with a placeholder for the interpolated value.
Hardcoded English text in a template literal rendered as JSX content — move the literal part into a next-intl key with a placeholder for the interpolated value.
